test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.**

Suspicious

Although the web server was problematic, Sudha was certain that she will submit her form on the portal by evening.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Certain**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is "suspicious".
 
• **Suspicious **means a feeling of doubt or mistrust, often suggesting that something seems not quite right or may be indicative of potential wrongdoing. (संदिग्ध)
 
 
• **Example**: *His suspicious behaviour in the store caught the attention of the security guard.*
 
 
 
• An antonym is being asked, which means a word opposite in meaning to "suspicious".
 
• "**Certain**" means having no doubt or being confident, which is opposite to the feeling of suspicion. (निश्चित)
 
 
• **Example**: *She displayed a certain confidence that set her apart in the group.*
 
 
 
• Grammatically, "certain" is an adjective that can be used to describe a person's state of mind or level of confidence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Problematic **means difficult or troublesome. (समस्यात्मक)
 
• **Submit **means to present or hand in something for consideration, approval, or judgment. (जमा करना)
 
• **Portal **is a noun that refers to a website or online platform. (प्रवेशमार्ग)
